page.notes: Mark {1} and {2} stand in the text and the margin notes repeat them as printed ("1 Pet.2.13.", "Psal. 82.6,"). Scripture reference marks are printed as superscript numerals. Doubtful readings: "ec" at the start of the page is a fragment with the first letter hidden in the gutter; "prætextu" (possibly misprinted); both Greek phrases in the text ("κτίας ἀνθρωπίνη" and the two "διὰ" phrases) are uncertain and marked [?]. The "Paulus." line under the column is set small and italic and is read as the end of the sentence. "competant;" is read as the last line of the sentence, not as a catchword. The left-edge text and the lower-left fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded. Section numbers "I." and "2." in the right margin are listed as notes.
